rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with an expanded blastocyst and thinning zona, but it overstates certainty about ICM/TE being clearly A-grade from this single image and likely misidentifies internal structures such as a possible polar body/debris location.
Thoroughly integrates maternal age, ovarian reserve, prior live birth, tubal factor, sperm parameters, BMI, endometrium, and protocol with embryo morphology and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, especially around age-related aneuploidy limiting prognosis despite good morphology; minor issue is somewhat optimistic quantitative adjustment and a few speculative inferences.

Largely aligned with Gardner grading concepts and standard IVF practice, including SET and counseling on age-related aneuploidy; however, some recommendations (routine estradiol adjustment, strong PGT-A framing, aspirin specifics) are more practice-dependent than guideline-mandated.
Provides clear practical recommendations for transfer management, monitoring, counseling, and future-cycle planning with specific options and contingencies.
